apps.name: Dispatcher
apps.description: Schedule outbound pickups and inbound arrivals, track load progress, and view daily timelines.
apps.releaseNotes:
Dispatcher 1.1.3

Swipe left or right on Inbounds and Outbounds to select the next or previous filter. A swipe must cover at least a quarter of the page width, with a 96 dp minimum, before switching on release. Short swipes, vertical scrolling, and search-field gestures do not switch filters. The Today page retains its existing timeline gestures.

Loading dots on Print and Start Loading buttons now draw as one compact indicator, preventing device fonts or display sizes from wrapping the dots onto another line.

Install over the existing app to retain saved settings and authorization. The package ID and signing certificate are unchanged.

apps.name: MES Radio
apps.description: Push-to-talk for your MES team. Talk on radio channels and replay received voice.
apps.releaseNotes:
MES Radio 1.0.7

Live speech gets progressively quieter when the speaker is estimated to be within 5 meters. At 5 meters or beyond, it uses your saved Quiet, Medium or Loud level. Live speech is reduced, not fully muted.
Recordings keep their original audio, and Replay plays at your saved listening level regardless of how close the speaker was.
Works for regular channels and Broadcast. A nearby-speaker status explains when live volume is lowered.

Both phones must enable location sharing and have fresh positions reporting accuracy of 5 meters or better. Missing, old or imprecise positions leave live volume unchanged. Location remains an estimate, and sharing stops when the app leaves the foreground; this does not guarantee feedback prevention. Two-phone proximity and acoustic testing remain pending.

Keeps the Broadcast speaker toggle, speech-reactive glow, radar stabilization and connection recovery from previous releases.
Android 9 or newer. Updates MES Radio in place and preserves sign-in, settings and voice history. Do not uninstall before updating.

apps.name: MES Run Beta
apps.description: Run production, coordinate MES staff, and follow line progress in an isolated test environment.
apps.releaseNotes:
MES Run Beta 18 - compact widget and easier sign-in

What's new
- Compact home-screen widget with three columns: machine picture and small status, running product above a progress bar and percentage, and the Start/Stop action.
- The widget uses confirmed production against the current target and requests a shorter, single-row launcher size. Start/Stop opens the existing production review or stop-reason flow.
- The last successful supervisor PIN is remembered securely and stays masked on the login screen. Logging out clears it; an expired session keeps it available for signing in again.
- Added Pillow Inspection and Pillow Weighing to the line and step picture lists, matching the existing industrial artwork with transparent backgrounds.

Try it
Update MES Run Beta in MES Store. Add or resize the MES Run Production widget, review progress, and open Stop. Sign out to check that the PIN field clears. In line configuration, select Pillow Inspection or Pillow Weighing and save.

Environment and limits
This beta uses the isolated sample production environment with authorized MES product, staff and parameter references. It does not operate live factory production. Existing sample history is preserved. Pallet label printing remains a separate app.
Android controls widget sizing and background refresh. Stale data offers Review before production actions. Physical-device and independent MES Store installation checks remain outstanding; current emulator checks use the debug app.

apps.name: MES Store
apps.description: Browse and install approved MES apps, read guides, and keep your apps up to date.
apps.releaseNotes:
MES Store 1.2.24

Migrates release approval to the replacement signing authority and a separate catalog for updated stores. APK identity, signature, checksum, and release-approval verification remain required.

Install this APK directly over the existing MES Store. Do not uninstall. The Android signing certificate and package ID are unchanged, so settings and app data are preserved.

This is a one-time manual update: older stores trust the unavailable original approval key and cannot authorize this migration through their built-in updater. Their original catalog remains available. After installing 1.2.24, subsequent approved updates use the replacement authority.

Requires Android 9 or newer.
